summary: Verified the ZERODHA CNC-downgrade-to-MIS bug fix in the copy-trading follower translator chain. Ran TypeScript typecheck (exit 0) and every regression harness under backend/tests/*.cjs (17 files). All harnesses green including the new zerodha_copy_product_cnc_harness.cjs which asserts the Zerodha placeOrder payload receives product='CNC' (not 'MIS') end-to-end through translateFollowerOrder + FollowerExecutionService, plus NRML->NRML, MIS->MIS, and omitted->MIS (backward-compatible default). Fyers/Upstox/ICICI/Shoonya translation paths and manual-trade harnesses unchanged.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and correct: follower-order-translator.ts ZERODHA case line 53 now emits `product: params.product ?? 'MIS'` preserving backward compatibility.
TranslateFollowerOrderParams.product is optional (`string | null`) — safe additive change.
CopyTradingService passes event.product from master ManualTrade (line 206) — full chain preserved.
Suggestion (non-blocking): consider validating product against a whitelist ('CNC'|'MIS'|'NRML') at the translator boundary to reject junk values from upstream instead of silently forwarding.
test_credentials: N/A - static harness validation, no auth/broker calls
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static validation monorepo (pnpm). No servers, no DB. Run `corepack pnpm --filter @cts/api typecheck` and `node backend/tests/<harness>.cjs`. Target harness for this bug: zerodha_copy_product_cnc_harness.cjs (14/14). Other key harnesses: zerodha_order_payload (29/29), zerodha_follower_execution (38/38), instrument_translation (33/33).
rca of the issue: RCA: apps/api/src/brokers/execution/follower-order-translator.ts had `product: 'MIS'` hard-coded in the ZERODHA branch, ignoring the master's product. FIX applied by main agent threads the master product through the chain: CopyTradingService.handleTrade -> FollowerExecutionService.place (params.product) -> translateFollowerOrder (params.product ?? 'MIS') -> Zerodha payload. Reproduction: master CNC ManualTrade -> before fix, Zerodha placeOrder received product='MIS' -> Kite rejected after 3:12 PM with 'Intraday orders (MIS) are allowed only till 3:12 PM'. Post-fix verified: CNC->CNC, NRML->NRML, MIS->MIS, undefined->MIS default. No regressions in other brokers or manual-trade flows.
